tweet_summary: NewsWire reports that Condoleezza Rice was seen entering the White House on March 6, 2026 (per CNN). The illustrative image is a 2004 file photo of Rice with President George W. Bush at her Secretary of State nomination announcement.
why_note_decision: The substantive claim is TRUE: Rice did visit the White House on 6 March 2026 — she attended a Trump-chaired roundtable on college sports/NIL in the East Room (confirmed by multiple outlets including Yahoo Sports, CBS Sports, The Daily Beast, IBTimes). Using a 2004 file photo as illustration is standard for news wire posts and isn't deceptive — the visit itself is real and the photo is of the same person being reported on. The note pedantically points at the file photo while the headline claim it would be 'correcting' is true. 20 raters tagged NNN.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note.
